verdict.rationale: Casium's site promises 'one clear price' and 'No billable hours. No RFE or assessment fees', but the price itself is not published. Nothing in the evidence shows a pricing page that separates Casium's own fees from USCIS filing fees or premium processing costs. Fee transparency is a fair axis for an immigration law-firm and platform, so the lack of evidence makes this 'none' rather than 'na'.

support.subject: As a founder, the provider's pricing pages separate its own fees from USCIS filing fees and premium processing, so the all-in cost is honest
